title: Preparation requirement
purpose: Require an explicit independent preparation aliquot for new observations of one exact analytical test.

sections.title: Create, edit and access
paragraphs: Only administrators can open and save this form; other staff read these values on the QC configuration page, where the rows are not links for them. Add creates a new configuration record; Edit prepopulates the existing record and requires a Reason for change. Unknown configuration kinds are unavailable. These are lab policy values, and synthetic seed data is not a validated set.

items.label: Definition
items.description: Required analytical test (method/version, analyte and matrix). Catalog definitions are available, including inactive definitions; the relationship is per exact test.

items.label: Required preparation method
items.description: Required active method/version used for the independent preparation batch. Only active catalog methods are available as choices.

items.label: Basis
items.description: Required laboratory method/SOP source and applicability. Explain why this exact preparation method applies.

items.label: Is active
items.description: Initially checked. When active, new entries and relevant review checks require an explicit prepared aliquot matching this preparation method. Unchecking preserves history and stops enforcing this requirement for new work.

sections.title: Relationships and effects
paragraphs: Only one preparation requirement can exist for each definition, including inactive rows. Edit the existing record to change the required preparation version.

An analytical result still belongs to its analytical batch; the selected prepared aliquot separately identifies the physical preparation batch/member and its requested-test membership. A timestamp on an analytical batch does not satisfy an independent preparation identity.

The aliquot must be available and noncancelled, belong to the same physical sample/matrix and requested test, use the required method/version, and have actual preparation start recorded. Analysis must occur at or after completion when recorded, otherwise start. Linked preparation QC also participates in approval.

Changing current preparation policy does not manufacture historical links. New revisions use current requirements. Existing explicit links remain validated; issued reports preserve their frozen lineage. Absence of an active requirement does not establish that physical preparation is unnecessary.

items.label: Add preparation requirement
items.description: Create the exact test-to-preparation relationship and audit event, then return to QC configuration.

sections.title: Save, cancel and history
paragraphs: Validation errors preserve entered form values. A stale record is refused rather than overwriting another person’s edit; input stays visible, but reload and compare current values before saving again. A reload is a new form, so retain any needed unsaved notes before leaving.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Optional on creation; required nonblank for every existing-row save. Recorded with actor, time and before/after values.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: For an edit, validate fields and uniqueness, recheck that the record still matches the version opened, and save with its audit event. The Add form’s named submit button creates instead. Success returns to QC configuration.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Return to QC configuration without saving typed changes.

items.label: History
items.description: Existing records show their latest 20 audit events, displayed oldest to newest, with action, actor, time and reason. No history section appears before any events exist.
